title: Single Race setup gets the Freestyle course picker
summary: Single Race setup now lists every published race course (32: Enduro, Nationals, Supercross) under event tabs with photo cards, a large preview with previous/next arrows and a Start Race button, Laps and CPU riders steppers below; Copy ride link sits beside Back. Q/E or shoulder buttons switch tabs; accepting the list starts the race.
details: The last started race's course, laps and CPU riders are remembered across visits (like the last Freestyle course); browsing without starting does not overwrite it.

Verification: unit tests pass; content browser tests (test_race_courses with env01 and sx03, test_menu_preferences, test_race) pass; screenshots checked at desktop, tablet, short landscape and portrait.
limitation: Menu-only change; race gameplay unchanged; on very short portrait phones (~640px tall) the course list shows about two courses at a time and scrolls.
